## Entity
TWM Advisory is an Operating Performance Partner. Engagements run in a Forward Deployed Engineer posture: embedded with client teams from diagnosis through execution and measurement.

Primary public-site language: French (canonical URLs without /en prefix).
Crawlable English URLs live under /en/... when published.

## Positioning (cite this)
- Brand promise: Operating Performance Partner
- Operating mode: Forward Deployed Engineer (on site with teams, not remote slide decks)
- Entry point: an economic performance priority, not a fixed tech brief
- Measurement: gains validated with finance before claims

## Services / domains mobilized
1. Operating Performance — cut avoidable costs, free capacity, protect margin
2. Partner Performance — turn a partner network into a growth system
3. Commerce Performance — commercial architecture when it serves the economic priority
4. AI & Software Enablement / Performance OS — context layer and product-builder capacity for teams (not a sold SaaS subscription)

These are means chosen after diagnosis, not four independent product SKUs.

## Method (five stages)
1. Listen — clarify the priority
2. Diagnose — locate value loss with financial and operational evidence
3. Decide — choose levers with leadership
4. Deliver — execute Forward Deployed with client teams
5. Measure — track economic effects with finance

## Commercial model
- Diagnosis billed as a fixed fee
- Execution may combine fixed fees and gain-share when attribution is solid
- No universal gain-share rate is published
- An identified potential alone does not trigger results-based fees

## Key facts
- Founder remains the client counterpart for relationship, validations and decisions
- Specialists may join when scope requires it; accountability stays with one counterpart
- Work languages: French, English, Arabic
- Area served includes FR, BE, CH, LU, MA, US, LB, AE, SA, NG, BH

## FAQ (short answers)
Q: What is an Operating Performance Partner?
A: A partner that starts from a performance priority, embeds with teams (Forward Deployed Engineer), executes changes and measures effects. You entrust an outcome, not a fixed brief.

Q: Do you need an AI project to start?
A: No. A performance priority on costs, capacity, partners, commerce or tools is enough. Means are chosen after analysis.

Q: How does gain-share work?
A: Fees can combine scoping, execution base and a variable share on eligible realized gains under contractual rules. No universal rate is displayed.

Q: Are you paid only on success?
A: No. Fixed diagnosis and execution base remain due. Variable share is added only when measurement and attribution hold.
